title: Confirmed booking returns embedded patient SMS result from createEvent
description: The caller asks to book a first consultation, explicitly requests an SMS confirmation, selects the first slot, confirms synthetic identity details, and then confirms the booking. On the first slot offer, the assistant should name doctor Magdalena Szajnar, and on the final pre-booking summary it should repeat the legacy first-visit pricing and tomography wording. The assistant should not call a separate patient-SMS tool. Instead, createEvent should complete the booking and return the embedded booking-confirmation SMS result.
